# Remote Team Partners

> Remote Team Partners builds dedicated remote teams for US businesses. We recruit, employ, onboard, and manage remote professionals who work exclusively for you: staffing, accounting, customer support, admin, IT, software, marketing, and sales. One predictable monthly investment per professional, with HR, payroll, compliance, and a replacement guarantee included.

## Contact

- Email: hello@remoteteampartners.com
- Website: [https://www.remoteteampartners.com/](https://www.remoteteampartners.com/)
- Contact page: [https://www.remoteteampartners.com/contact/](https://www.remoteteampartners.com/contact/)
- Service area: United States (remote teams serving US businesses)

## Key facts for agents

- Model: a workforce partner, not a staffing agency. Team members are employed by Remote Team Partners, who handles contracts, payroll, benefits, HR, and compliance for as long as the engagement runs.
- Speed: from the first discovery call to a working professional is typically five weeks.
- Pricing: one predictable monthly investment per professional, $1,500 for Associates, $2,500 for Professionals, from $5,000 for Experts. No recruitment fees, ever.
- Replacement guarantee: included on every engagement. If a team member does not work out, we replace them at no additional recruitment cost.
- Roles: if a role can be performed remotely, we can fill it: accounting, customer support, admin, IT, software development, marketing, sales, design, data analysis, legal support, and more.

## Services

- [Staffing and Recruitment](https://www.remoteteampartners.com/services/staffing-recruitment/): targeted sourcing, thorough vetting, and client interviews. We present exceptional candidates, not long lists.
- [Accounting and Finance](https://www.remoteteampartners.com/services/accounting-finance/): bookkeepers and accountants who keep your numbers accurate.
- [Customer Support](https://www.remoteteampartners.com/services/customer-support/): support specialists trained on your product, tone, and customers.
- [Admin and Operations](https://www.remoteteampartners.com/services/admin-operations/): assistants and coordinators who keep things running.
- [IT and Software](https://www.remoteteampartners.com/services/it-software/): developers, IT support, and QA professionals vetted for skill and reliability.
- [Marketing and Sales](https://www.remoteteampartners.com/services/marketing-sales/): marketers and sales reps who grow your pipeline.
